stories.title: SteamDB is now part of Nexus Mods.
stories.summary:
SteamDB, the website that tracks PC game prices, updates, and player numbers, is now part of Nexus Mods. The current owner of SteamDB, xPaw, has been looking for the right owner after “experiencing burnout with the project.” Nexus Mods says SteamDB will continue to exist separately to Nexus Mods, and “everything currently available for free will remain free.” The browser extension will continue to be maintained, and Nexus Mods is looking at exploring connecting the two communities to “see what is possible over time.”
[Link: SteamDB Joins Nexus Mods | https://steamdb.info/blog/steamdb-nexus-mods/ | SteamDB]
